verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Unmovable, unshakable
Let my roots go down deep
Unmovable, unshakable
In You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I want to be like a tree
Planted by the streams
Of living water

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
This will be my song God
This will be my prayer
Until the end, until the end
